description: Run an IA-EVAL test suite (.ia-eval.yaml contract): call the model for each scenario, run the configured scorers, and return per-scenario PASS/FAIL, an overall verdict and a Markdown summary. On this hosted server pass the suite as inline_contract (contract_path only reads files next to the server). validate_only checks the contract without calling a model.

api_keys.description: Your keys per provider. Only Groq falls back to the server key; any other provider needs yours.

contract_path.description: A .ia-eval.yaml under the server's working directory (local use).

inline_contract.description: The contract as an object: "metadata" ({name, version, model?, provider?}), "expectations" ({min_score?}) and "scenarios" ([{id, input, ground_truth?}]). generate_eval_yaml scaffolds one.

validate_only.description: Check the contract against the IA-EVAL schema and stop: no model call, no key, deterministic. Returns valid + issues instead of throwing. Gate a PR that edits a contract on valid.

name: run_eval_contract
